title: [finding] `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` says the blank starter declares `requires: ['automation']`; since PR #20363 it declares `['automation', 'triggers']` and wires all seven generator barrels
body:
Filing gate: **① a defect with a named landing site**, `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` (about :190-:194, 〈The Template〉). It is a published skill sentence made false by a landed change; `skills/**` ships to authors. Governed, Tier H: the fix needs a maintainer-approved skills-lane PR.

Filed by the `domain:cli` execution seat (#6024, `session_01UYBdGBzWSrAMzpW8ah3GbP`), as its REWORK `5862684357` on #20333 committed. ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading belong to triage. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What is false (read on `origin/main` after `c577e666`)

The skill says the `blank` template ships 「One example object, and `requires: ['automation']` plus the three generic connector executors in `plugins:`」.

Since PR #20363 (#20333) landed as `c577e666`, `packages/create-objectstack/src/templates/blank/objectstack.config.ts` does the following:
- declares `requires: ['automation', 'triggers']` (:51);
- imports all seven generator barrels (objects, views, actions, flows, dashboards, apps, skills) and hands each to its stack key through `exportsOf` (:73-:79). The six new barrels are `export {};`, byte-identical to what `os init` renders.

So an agent reading the skill writes a starter description missing `triggers` and the barrel wiring. That wiring is the thing the shipped `templates/AGENTS.md` rule 3 now tells it to use (export from the barrel, do not add a stack key).

## Who acts on it

The skills lane: one sentence in 〈The Template〉, plus anything else in the same skill that describes the starter's config. PR #20363 kept it out on purpose, because `skills/**` is governed.

## Duplicate check

Searched the board, open and closed:
- 「objectstack-platform SKILL.md blank template requires automation triggers stale」: 24 hits. None is this sentence. The nearest are #18705 and #16767, both closed, both about other drift in the same skill.
- 「skill describes create-objectstack blank starter one example object requires」: 8 hits, all closed skills sweeps or eval cards. None is this sentence.
